comment: Labeled retrieval query set v2 (grounding-RAG G-I track expansion): every v1 case verbatim (unchanged, append-only) plus 18 new cases for quant_dev / data_scientist / product_manager and the new specific-article SWE/MLE docs. Judged against the FETCHED CONTENT of snapshot snap_26c44499e582a96a on 2026-07-06 (operator delegated the judging to the implementing session; evidence per case in notes). Dropped from the draft: rq_mle_ml_engineer_levels (levels.fyi ML-engineer page fetched as 0 bytes, no doc covers it), and no data-science-interview-questions case (interviewquery.com returned HTTP 429). Known conservatism: v1 labels were NOT retro-extended to newly added documents, so a new doc that genuinely answers a v1 query scores as a miss - measured metrics are a lower bound. Append-only from here: extend via a new version, never edit committed cases.
